_comment: French titles for the CWE entries shipped in cwe-names.json. NOT a MITRE publication — MITRE publishes CWE in English only. The report shows the English original alongside every translated title (tooltip in HTML, parentheses in .doc) so the MITRE wording stays searchable, and the Methodology chapter states the provenance. Any CWE absent here falls back to English.
